attempts.summary: Implemented directly during bootstrap (commit 7b92c57): PreToolUse hook gated on KB_TASK; decidePermission() in model.js (unit-tested) allows file tools inside the repo and shell commands whose every segment is allowlisted, denies force-push/sudo/rm -rf and unlisted commands with an actionable reason; hkb init installs it next to the Stop hook. Workers can no longer strand on permission prompts.

residual_risk: policy parser splits on &&/;/| only — subshells $( ) are not inspected; acceptable inside a worktree
